decisive_spans.text: Multiple nodules appeared on the upper back 1 year previously
Several 0.5- to 1-cm, dome-shaped, red papules and nodules

response.rationale: The presence of multiple nodules and dome-shaped papules, along with the chronic and progressive nature of the skin condition, strongly supports Mycosis Fungoides. While Sézary Syndrome shares some features, the absence of atypical cells in the peripheral blood makes it less likely.
